items.title_en: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.abstract_en: Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once. It is the most accurate of the compared systems on four of five QA benchmarks. It reaches 91.4% on LoCoMo and 72.6% on LongMemEval-S, where it leads the strongest baseline by 14.3 points, and with AutoDream disabled it gains 31.0 and 22.0 points over HyperMem on single-hop and multi-hop document QA. As procedural memory, it yields the highest mean success among the compared memory methods on ALFWorld and WebShop and reaches 49.2% on MetaClaw-Bench, against 44.0% for MetaClaw's skill library. Six typed memory agents keep complete records as the system of record, and a provenance hypergraph indexes episodic and semantic records with n-ary frames that cite their rows. Retrieval runs under explicit budgets, so the evidence a question inspects does not grow with the history. AutoDream merges duplicate anchors outside the write path without rewriting any record, and it distills task sessions into skills. With AutoDream disabled, MIRIX-2.0 answers faster than HyperMem on all five timed benchmarks. It needs no fine-tuning, runs with closed and open models, and its code is public.

recommendation.reason_zh: 比较智能体如何存储与检索长期记忆，并在记忆中记录信息来源。作者提供框架实现。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 端到端效果依赖数据库、检索配置与被测智能体，仓库本身不能证明可达到论文的评测成绩。

items.title_zh: MIRIX-2.0：多智能体记忆系统
items.abstract_zh: 长期记忆使 LLM 智能体能够个性化、保持一致并复用此前有效的做法。参数化记忆需要训练，整合可能永久丢失细节，而保留每条记录会留下一个不断增长、需要搜索的存储。我们提出 MIRIX-2.0，一个多智能体记忆系统，设计目标是同时做到实用、准确和高效。在五个 QA 基准中的四个上，它是所比较系统中最准确的。它在 LoCoMo 上达到 91.4%，在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 72.6%，在该基准上以 14.3 分领先最强基线；在禁用 AutoDream 时，它在单跳和多跳文档 QA 上分别比 HyperMem 提升 31.0 分和 22.0 分。作为程序性记忆，它在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上在所比较的记忆方法中取得最高平均成功率，并在 MetaClaw-Bench 上达到 49.2%，而 MetaClaw 的技能库为 44.0%。六个类型化记忆智能体作为记录系统保存完整记录，一个溯源超图用 n 元帧索引情景记录和语义记录，这些帧引用其所在行。检索在显式预算下运行，因此问题所检查的证据不会随历史增长。AutoDream 在写路径之外合并重复锚点，且不重写任何记录，并将任务会话蒸馏为技能。禁用 AutoDream 时，MIRIX-2.0 在所有五个计时基准上回答速度快于 HyperMem。它无需微调，可与闭源和开源模型一起运行，代码公开。

items.title_en: ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision
items.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual perception requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to locate and interpret subtle evidence within complex scenes. Constructing supervision for this ability is challenging: questions must have correct, unambiguous answers that depend on actual fine-grained visual details rather than coarse cues or language priors. Verifying these properties makes manual annotation labor-intensive and automatic generation difficult for models that themselves struggle with fine-grained perception. Yet the same models can often recognize such details once the region is zoomed in. We exploit this global-to-zoom perception gap and introduce ZoomGain, a data construction pipeline that constructs questions about the full image from visual information gained only by zooming in. It verifies each answer on the zoomed view with multiple models, ensures that each question remains unambiguous in the full image and cannot be answered from language priors, and specifically generates high-quality distractors for multiple-choice questions. With this pipeline and human-only screening (no manual QA editing), we build ZoomGainBench, a 1,000-question bilingual benchmark on which the best of 28 VLMs achieves only 61.08. Failure analysis reveals that models favor a particular type of distractor when answering multiple-choice questions incorrectly. Beyond evaluation, training on just 9K ZoomGain samples substantially improves the visual perception capabilities of our 4B/9B models, enabling them to outperform several hundred-billion-parameter models across various perception benchmarks. The trained 9B model achieves SoTA performance on several benchmarks, such as 90.25 on HR-Bench 4K. These results establish global-to-zoom perception gaps as a practical basis for scaling fine-grained visual supervision for both evaluation and training. Our code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/ZoomGain.

items.title_zh: ZoomGain：挖掘全局到放大的感知差距以进行细粒度视觉监督
items.abstract_zh: 细粒度视觉感知要求视觉语言模型（VLM）在复杂场景中定位并解释细微证据。为这种能力构建监督很困难：问题必须具有正确、无歧义的答案，且答案取决于实际的细粒度视觉细节，而不是粗粒度线索或语言先验。验证这些性质使人工标注劳动密集，而自动生成对于自身在细粒度感知上有困难的模型而言也很困难。然而，同样的模型一旦将区域放大，往往就能识别这些细节。我们利用这种全局到放大的感知差距，提出 ZoomGain，一个数据构建流程，它仅根据通过放大获得的视觉信息来构建关于完整图像的问题。它用多个模型在放大视图上验证每个答案，确保每个问题在完整图像中仍然无歧义且不能从语言先验回答，并专门为多项选择题生成高质量干扰项。借助该流程和仅人工筛选（不进行人工 QA 编辑），我们构建了 ZoomGainBench，一个包含 1,000 个问题的双语基准，在 28 个 VLM 中最佳者仅达到 61.08。失败分析揭示，模型在错误回答多项选择题时偏好某一类干扰项。除评估外，仅用 9K 个 ZoomGain 样本训练就能显著提升我们 4B/9B 模型的视觉感知能力，使其在各种感知基准上优于若干千亿参数模型。训练后的 9B 模型在多个基准上取得 SoTA 性能，例如在 HR-Bench 4K 上达到 90.25。这些结果确立了全局到放大感知差距作为扩展用于评估和训练的细粒度视觉监督的实用基础。我们的代码见 https://github.com/inclusionAI/ZoomGain。

items.title_en: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
items.abstract_en: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, we show that, under a fixed nominal information budget, group size should scale quadratically with the per-axis spatial compression factor. Building on this principle, we propose GSTAR, a spatial--group co-scaling framework that enables \(32\times\) and even effective \(64\times\) compression while preserving strong reconstruction, understanding, and generation performance. Since larger groups introduce intra-group dependencies that must be modeled efficiently, we analyze their impact on inference latency and generation quality and introduce a semi-autoregressive decoder that combines parallel feature computation with lightweight causal modeling. With these designs, our highly compressed models perform competitively with leading models across five representative text-to-image benchmarks (GenEval, DPG-Bench, PRISM, LongText-Bench, and Qwen-Image-Bench). At \(1024\times1024\) resolution, our model delivers a \(20\times\) speedup over prior discrete autoregressive models, generating each image in 2.5 seconds on a single NVIDIA H200. Together, these results show that highly compressed discrete representations can enable high-quality autoregressive generation at low latency.

items.title_zh: G-STAR：面向深度压缩自回归生成的组缩放 token 容量
items.abstract_zh: 离散自回归模型为图像生成提供了可扩展框架。然而，它们面临一个基本权衡：长 token 序列能保持表示质量但会拖慢生成，而激进的空间压缩会降低表示容量。基于乘积量化，我们表明，在固定的名义信息预算下，组大小应随每轴空间压缩因子呈二次方缩放。基于这一原则，我们提出 GSTAR，一个空间—组协同缩放框架，可在保持较强重建、理解和生成性能的同时实现 32× 乃至有效的 64× 压缩。由于更大的组会引入必须在效率上建模的组内依赖，我们分析其对推理延迟和生成质量的影响，并引入一个半自回归解码器，将并行特征计算与轻量因果建模相结合。借助这些设计，我们的高度压缩模型在五个代表性文本到图像基准（GenEval、DPG-Bench、PRISM、LongText-Bench 和 Qwen-Image-Bench）上与领先模型竞争。在 1024×1024 分辨率下，我们的模型相较先前的离散自回归模型实现 20× 加速，在单块 NVIDIA H200 上每 2.5 秒生成一张图像。这些结果共同表明，高度压缩的离散表示能够在低延迟下实现高质量自回归生成。

items.title_en: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
items.title_zh: Open Vision Banana：面向生成式视觉感知的完全开放方案
items.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (OVB), a fully open and reproducible recipe for converting pretrained generators into unified multi-task perception systems. Our analyses identify the design choices that matter most for generalization, including color encoding, prompt design, parameter adaptation, and task balancing. These choices interact, so individually helpful choices can hurt when combined with others. Starting from 4B and 9B parameter open-weight base models and using 2.1M-3.8M training pairs from public datasets, OVB surpasses Vision Banana's reported Cityscapes zero-shot performance (73.9 vs. 69.9 mIoU) and rivals state-of-the-art affine-invariant depth estimators. Its non-zero-shot variants come within five points of Vision Banana on referring and reasoning segmentation but remain further behind on instance segmentation. All models largely retain the base model's image-editing abilities. With legend ensembling, we introduce a test-time scaling method for generator-based perception. It segments an image under several class-color legends and fuses the results by majority vote, correcting unstable color-class bindings and improving mIoU by up to 8.7 points on Cityscapes and 15.0 points on COCO-Object without retraining. We release the dataset construction and processing pipeline, the training and evaluation code, as well as the final, intermediate, and ablation checkpoints. Project website: https://openvisionbanana.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，预训练图像生成器编码了超越图像合成的真实世界理解。Vision Banana 通过将视觉任务表述为条件图像编辑来利用这一点。然而，其数据、权重、代码和实现细节未公开。我们提出 Open Vision Banana（OVB），一个完全开放且可复现的方案，用于将预训练生成器转换为统一的多任务感知系统。我们的分析识别了对泛化最重要的设计选择，包括颜色编码、提示设计、参数自适应和任务平衡。这些选择相互作用，因此单独有益的选择在与其他选择结合时可能有害。从 4B 和 9B 参数的开源权重基础模型出发，并使用来自公开数据集的 210 万–380 万训练对，OVB 超越了 Vision Banana 报告的 Cityscapes 零样本性能（73.9 对 69.9 mIoU），并与最先进的仿射不变深度估计器相当。其非零样本变体在指代分割和推理分割上距 Vision Banana 五个点以内，但在实例分割上仍落后更多。所有模型在很大程度上保留了基础模型的图像编辑能力。通过图例集成，我们引入了一种用于基于生成器的感知的测试时扩展方法。它在若干类别-颜色图例下分割图像，并通过多数投票融合结果，纠正不稳定的颜色-类别绑定，并在无需重新训练的情况下将 Cityscapes 上的 mIoU 提高最多 8.7 个点、COCO-Object 上提高 15.0 个点。我们发布数据集构建与处理流程、训练和评估代码，以及最终、中间和消融检查点。项目网站：https://openvisionbanana.github.io

items.title_en: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. We find that acceptance rates decrease from 46% in the lowest visual-dependence quartile to 22% in the highest, with this disparity persisting after multimodal training. Motivated by this observation, we propose MMFlash, a simple and effective framework that adaptively upweights visually dependent tokens that the drafter predicts poorly. For long video inputs, MMFlash further employs sparse attention to reduce redundant attention computation and improve drafting quality. Across various multimodal benchmarks, MMFlash achieves lossless decoding speedups of up to $3.58\times$, outperforming EAGLE-3 and DFlash by up to 195.4% and 17.1%, respectively.

recommendation.reason_zh: 为视觉语言模型改进推测解码，作者仓库提供实现和基准脚本，可对照生成吞吐量。

items.title_zh: MMFlash：加速视觉语言模型的推测解码
items.abstract_zh: 投机解码通过让轻量草稿模型提出 token，由目标模型并行验证，从而加速生成。DFlash 等扩散草稿模型在单次前向传播中提出整个 token 块，但主要关注纯文本任务，多模态草稿仍未得到充分探索。为研究这一设定，我们首先引入一种基于有/无视觉输入时下一 token 分布之间 KL 散度的 token 级视觉依赖度量。我们发现，接受率从最低视觉依赖四分位的 46% 降至最高四分位的 22%，且这种差距在多模态训练后仍然存在。受此观察启发，我们提出 MMFlash，一个简单有效的框架，自适应地提高草稿模型预测较差的视觉依赖 token 的权重。对于长视频输入，MMFlash 进一步采用稀疏注意力以减少冗余注意力计算并提升草稿质量。在各种多模态基准上，MMFlash 实现最高 3.58× 的无损解码加速，分别比 EAGLE-3 和 DFlash 高出最高 195.4% 和 17.1%。

items.title_en: HARP-Bench: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Around Active Humans
items.abstract_en: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, complete part of the task, temporarily change object availability, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Contribution, Interruption, and Co-presence. These conditions are instantiated through everyday manipulation tasks, including paired human-present variants for controlled comparison with standard manipulation. HARP-Bench also provides a demonstration-generation pipeline for dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies on HARP-Bench. Human-present variations challenge current policies, and higher task success does not consistently improve safety. Quantitative failure analysis identifies manipulation and recovery as the dominant remaining challenges. Training with HARP-Bench demonstrations improves human-present performance in simulation. A real-world study on one task family shows improved performance under human contribution, but not interruption, providing initial evidence of the data's utility and identifying limits of transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp.

items.title_zh: HARP-Bench：评测活跃人类周围机器人操作的基准
items.abstract_zh: 近期的机器人操作基准使得能够在多样物体、场景、指令和具身形态上系统评估通用机器人策略。然而，大多数现有基准仍假设机器人是唯一活跃智能体，且任务语义主要由指令和物体状态决定。这一假设忽略了现实世界变化的一个常见来源：人类主动共享工作空间。在此类设定中，人类可能揭示隐含目标、完成部分任务、临时改变物体可用性，或在附近工作时约束机器人的安全运动。我们提出 HARP-Bench，一个用于评估与活跃人类共享工作空间中机器人操作策略的基准。HARP-Bench 将人类活动视为操作问题的一部分，而不是背景场景变化。它将有人类在场的操作组织为四种条件：提示（Cueing）、贡献（Contribution）、中断（Interruption）和共在（Co-presence）。这些条件通过日常操作任务实例化，包括与标准操作进行受控比较的成对人类在场变体。HARP-Bench 还为动态人类在场设定提供演示生成流程。我们在 HARP-Bench 上评估 VLA 模型、模仿学习方法和启发式策略。人类在场变体对当前策略构成挑战，更高的任务成功率并不一定持续提升安全性。定量失败分析指出，操作和恢复是剩余的主要挑战。使用 HARP-Bench 演示进行训练可提升模拟中的人类在场性能。针对一个任务家族的真实世界研究表明，在人类贡献下性能提升，但在中断下没有提升，这提供了该数据有用性的初步证据，并识别了迁移的局限。代码见 https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp。

items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.

recommendation.reason_zh: 用任务反馈改进自蒸馏中的教师输出，再按监督可靠性给学生样本加权。适合对照不同后训练方法如何处理错误监督。

items.title_zh: 基于教师进化的同策略自蒸馏
items.abstract_zh: 同策略自蒸馏（On-Policy Self-Distillation, OPSD）通过特权上下文提示的自教师，将学生模型的 token 级分布与其对齐，已成为缓解序列级后训练范式中奖励稀疏性的一个有前景方向。然而，OPSD 在训练过程中往往无法实现持续的性能提升。在本文中，我们发现，模型有限的自教学能力是这一现象的根本原因，因为它会在某些样本上生成不可靠的指导。为解决该问题，我们提出教师进化自蒸馏（Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation, TESD），使自教师能够生成 rollout，并基于任务正确性和上下文独立性接收环境反馈。首先，利用这些奖励作为训练目标，我们执行面向教师的优化，以在蒸馏过程中持续增强模型的自教学能力。其次，通过从这些奖励估计教师指导的可靠性，我们应用自适应的面向学生优化，对指导不可靠的样本降权。跨多个数据集和模型规模的广泛实验表明，TESD 始终优于代表性的 token 级和序列级方法，突显了提升 OPSD 中监督质量的必要性。

items.title_en: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
items.title_zh: 拆解多模态视觉编码：视觉先验、专用容量与融合位置
items.abstract_en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型如何编码视觉输入仍无定论：多数用预训练视觉编码器，也有方案与语言模型联合从零训练甚至完全去掉编码器。编码器实际捆绑了三种设计选择：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量、以及把该容量置于多模态主干之前。由于公开模型在数据、架构与算力上各异，直接比较无法分离各因素。我们将所有模型在相同数据上从零预训练，并在等量生命周期算力下比较视觉问答与语言基准。结果显示视觉先验并非必需，联合从零训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量——无编码器模型即便扩大主干仍落后。但该容量不必位于融合前：在融合中向早期层加入纯视觉模块效果相当，还能降低首字延迟。这些结论支持与主干联合训练、置于主干早期的专用视觉容量。
items.highlight_zh: 视觉先验非必需，专用视觉容量才是关键
items.digest_zh:
【要解决的问题】能看图说话的多模态大模型，通常先用一个专门的视觉编码器把图片变成向量，再交给语言模型。这个编码器到底必要吗？它其实捆绑了三样东西：(1) 上游预训练带来的“视觉先验”；(2) 专门留给视觉的参数量；(3) 把视觉放在多模态融合之前的位置。以往公开模型在数据、结构、算力上都不一样，因此无法判断到底是哪一项在起作用。

【方法】作者把所有模型都放到同一份数据上从零开始训练，并让它们在整个训练生命周期内消耗相同的总算力，然后比较它们在视觉问答和纯语言任务上的表现，把三个因素逐一拆开来检验。

【结果】1) 视觉先验不是必需的：与语言模型一起从零训练的编码器，和预训练编码器打平，还省掉一个独立的训练阶段；2) 真正重要的是“专用视觉容量”——必须给视觉留出参数，把主干按编码器的参数量加大也补不回来；3) 容量不必放在融合之前：在融合过程中往主干靠前的层里插入视觉模块，效果差不多，还能更快吐出第一个 token。

【为何重要】这给多模态模型设计提供了清晰指引：不必执着于预训练视觉编码器，而应保留独立的视觉容量、与主干联合训练并放在早期层，同时也为降低推理延迟提供了可行方案。结论在多种主干规模下、以及把编码器预训练视作“免费”或从预训练语言模型出发时都成立。

items.title_en: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
items.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.

items.title_zh: MLIE-CoT：基于多级图像编辑的思维链推理
items.abstract_zh: 思维链（CoT）推理已被证明能通过将复杂任务分解为逐步解决方案来有效提升大语言模型的推理能力。近年来，研究者尝试将CoT推理扩展到视觉生成模型，以提升其处理复杂任务的能力。然而，现有用于文本到图像生成的CoT方法仍主要依赖文本推理，因此无法充分利用并保留图像中已有的正确语义信息，因为即使最详细的文本也无法捕捉所有视觉信息。随着图像生成技术的进步，FLUX和BAGEL等模型能够以视觉输入为条件生成图像。近期工作尝试在思维链中将图像作为上下文向前传递，但这带来了另一个限制：不合适的早期图像会强烈干扰模型，而重复的整图重生成会在每一轮引入新的幻觉并使其累积。为解决这些问题，我们提出MLIE-CoT，一种基于多级图像编辑的视觉思维链框架。MLIE-CoT学习从三个层级中选择修复粒度，在推理过程中尽可能保留正确语义，同时减少错误内容的影响。为提升多模态模型将不同严重程度的错误路由到适当修复层级的能力，我们构建了一个涵盖不同错误情况的图像修复数据集，并用其训练修复层级路由器。大量实验表明，MLIE-CoT显著优于其基础模型和使用固定修复策略的方法，在多个基准上取得明显提升。

items.title_en: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.title_zh: SplatAnything：面向多样场景的高斯间距归一化前馈三维重建
items.abstract_en: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.
items.abstract_zh: 我们指出已有前馈3DGS方法的一个关键局限：高斯属性通常在径向距离归一化空间中预测，该空间将重建几何的一个全局径向统计量规范化，而相邻高斯中心之间的间距在不同场景尺度和相机配置下仍可能显著变化。这种不匹配会导致高斯尺度目标出现系统性偏移，从而产生模糊的监督。为解决该问题，我们提出SplatAnything，并引入高斯间距归一化（GSNorm），它将高斯间距的一个稳健场景级统计量规范化，从而为高斯预测提供更一致的空间参考。为严格评估我们的方法，我们进一步建立了一个系统基准，涵盖多样数据集、输入稀疏度水平以及具有挑战性的外推视角。大量实验表明，SplatAnything达到最先进性能，在场景尺度和视角发生显著变化时增益尤为明显。

items.title_en: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
items.abstract_en: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline.

items.title_zh: Sightline：用于快速SVG生成的长窗口投机解码
items.abstract_zh: 可缩放矢量图形（SVG）生成模型将图形写为代码，每个token需要一次前向传播，因此绘制速度较慢。投机解码可以在无损情况下加速它们，而块式草稿器每次可猜测多个token。在SVG上，它们的许多轮次会接受整个草稿，并只在验证窗口处结束。我们发现其未命中很少且成簇出现，并且它们在块内比在自然语言中深入得多仍能保持准确。一个游程恒等式和三个命题表明，一旦候选足够宽，更长的窗口是有益的，直至草稿器的视野上限。我们提出Sightline，将窗口长度设为与草稿器视野一样长，并配以足够宽以填满该窗口的草稿树。实验涵盖文本到SVG和图像到SVG，使用三个模型，在来自MMSVG、MMSVG-2M和SArena的六个基准上进行。在每种设置下，Sightline都是所比较的无损解码器中最快的。在SArena上，当所有解码器共享同一循环控制时，它仍然最快。在来自另外四个模型家族的六个模型（其输出SVG代码、压缩SVG token或Lottie JSON）的几乎所有设置中，它也领先。分析将这一领先追溯到较短窗口会截断的轮次，无论是在无循环内容还是在循环中。投机解码也为通过渲染选择样本节省时间，这优于按似然选择。这些结果表明，在矢量图形上的投机解码应验证到草稿器所能看到的程度。代码和数据见 https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline。

items.title_en: Learning Low-Latency Action Verification for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Models
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

items.title_zh: 为冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型学习低延迟动作验证
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面取得了显著进展。然而，采样的动作序列可能无效，而使用计算昂贵的验证器评估替代方案会在每次策略查询时增加延迟。在这项工作中，我们提出 HDH，一个轻量级框架，利用冻结 VLA 自身部署中的后见经验来改进动作验证。该框架分为三个阶段。首先，我们部署策略并收集其自主 rollout。然后，我们训练一个紧凑的动作验证器，为每个动作块分配预测的任务成功分数。最后，冻结的 VLA 生成动作候选，验证器选择分数最高的候选执行。在四个 LIBERO-10 任务上，HDH 达到 82.3% 的平均成功率；在三个真实世界操作任务上，HDH 将平均成功率较基线策略提高 22.6%。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种非常有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。在本文中，我们描述了一个名为 XGBoost 的可扩展端到端树提升系统，数据科学家广泛使用它在许多机器学习挑战上取得最先进的结果。我们提出了一种针对稀疏数据的新型稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们提供了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩和分片的见解，以构建可扩展的树提升系统。通过结合这些见解，XGBoost 使用比现有系统少得多的资源，可扩展到数十亿个样本以上。

items.title_en: VAPOR: Improving Multimodal Reasoning with Sparse Visual Updates
items.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in visual reasoning, but extended generation over large visual contexts remains computationally expensive. During autoregressive decoding, visual attention is recomputed for every generated token, even when consecutive tokens rely on similar visual evidence. We introduce VAPOR (Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh), a training-free framework that reduces this redundancy by reusing visual attention outputs across decoding steps and refreshing them when needed. VAPOR caches the visual attention output while continuing to update textual attention at every step, helping reduce visual grounding drift during extended reasoning. To decide when to reuse cached outputs, VAPOR estimates visual attention mass using a low-rank approximation. It also uses prefill-based attention consistency and cache age to make independent Persist and Refresh decisions for each attention head. VAPOR retains the full visual key-value (KV) cache, so all visual tokens remain available when new evidence is needed. Experiments on eight image and four video reasoning benchmarks across two MLLM families show that VAPOR improves accuracy over dense attention on nearly all benchmarks while achieving 1.11-1.21x decoding speedups. Compared with the strongest state-of-the-art acceleration baseline in each setting, VAPOR further improves accuracy by 0.35-2.15 percentage points while achieving comparable or lower decoding latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Su-my/VAPOR.

items.title_zh: VAPOR：通过稀疏视觉更新改进多模态推理
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉推理方面已取得显著进展，但在大规模视觉上下文上进行长程生成仍然计算开销高昂。在自回归解码过程中，即使连续 token 依赖相似的视觉证据，每生成一个 token 仍会重新计算视觉注意力。我们提出 VAPOR（Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh，按需刷新的视觉注意力持久化），一个无需训练的框架，通过跨解码步骤复用视觉注意力输出并在需要时刷新，来减少这种冗余。VAPOR 缓存视觉注意力输出，同时在每一步继续更新文本注意力，有助于减少长程推理过程中的视觉 grounding 漂移。为决定何时复用缓存输出，VAPOR 使用低秩近似估计视觉注意力总量（attention mass）。它还使用基于预填充（prefill）的注意力一致性和缓存年龄，为每个注意力头独立做出 Persist 与 Refresh 决策。VAPOR 保留完整的视觉键值（KV）缓存，因此当需要新证据时所有视觉 token 仍可用。在两个 MLLM 系列上的八个图像和四个视频推理基准实验表明，VAPOR 在几乎所有基准上相较稠密注意力提高了准确率，同时实现 1.11-1.21 倍解码加速。与各设置下最强的先进加速基线相比，VAPOR 进一步将准确率提高 0.35-2.15 个百分点，同时实现相当或更低的解码延迟。代码见 https://github.com/Su-my/VAPOR。

items.title_en: CANDOR: Contrastive Self-Denoising Rewards for Label-Free Text-to-Image Post-Training
items.abstract_en: Post-training text-to-image generators with reinforcement learning usually relies on external reward models that need annotated preferences or auxiliary evaluators and are prone to reward hacking. We show that the generator's own denoising accuracy, used by a recent intrinsic reward, is a poor proxy for prompt fidelity. Within a same-prompt group, this absolute self-confidence is dominated by image complexity and ranks correct samples above incorrect ones near chance. We introduce CANDOR (Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio), the log-ratio of unconditional to conditional denoising errors under shared noise probes, which measures how much the prompt helps the model denoise its own sample. It cancels prompt-independent difficulty that scales both errors and ranks the better of two same-prompt samples higher in 60% and 63% of pairs on compositional generation and text rendering. As the only Flow-GRPO reward for a flow-matching model, CANDOR improves text rendering, aesthetic and human-preference scores over the base model and a prior absolute self-confidence reward, with text-rendering and preference gains that stronger classifier-free guidance does not reproduce. On public Flow-GRPO adapters trained on external rewards, CANDOR further raises PickScore and ImageReward, so it can complement those rewards. Code is available at https://github.com/jhlee0619/candor.

items.title_zh: CANDOR：用于无标签文本到图像后训练的对比自去噪奖励
items.abstract_zh: 使用强化学习对文本到图像生成器进行后训练通常依赖外部奖励模型，这些模型需要标注偏好或辅助评估器，并且容易受到奖励黑客攻击。我们表明，近期一种内在奖励所使用的生成器自身去噪准确率，是提示保真度的一个糟糕代理指标。在同一提示组内，这种绝对自置信度被图像复杂度主导，其将正确样本排在错误样本之上的能力接近随机水平。我们提出 CANDOR（Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio），即共享噪声探针下无条件去噪误差与条件去噪误差之比的对数，它衡量提示在多大程度上帮助模型去噪其自身样本。它抵消了会同时放大两种误差的提示无关难度，并在组合生成和文本渲染上分别于 60% 和 63% 的样本对中将同一提示下两个样本中更好的那个排得更高。作为流匹配模型唯一的 Flow-GRPO 奖励，CANDOR 在文本渲染、美学和人类偏好分数上优于基础模型和先前的绝对自置信度奖励，并且其文本渲染和偏好提升无法通过更强的无分类器引导复现。在基于外部奖励训练的公开 Flow-GRPO 适配器上，CANDOR 进一步提高了 PickScore 和 ImageReward，因此它可以补充这些奖励。代码见 https://github.com/jhlee0619/candor。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5D坐标（空间位置 (x,y,z) 和观察方向 (θ, φ)），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射亮度。我们通过查询沿相机光线的5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组相机位姿已知的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
items.abstract_en: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. We compare SSA with recurrent models, bounded-memory attention methods, and full-attention Transformers across retrieval, variable tracking, multi-hop reasoning, and language modeling. On our retrieval and reasoning benchmarks, SSA matches or comes within a few points of full attention on most tasks, far outperforms a Transformer with the same readable budget on every long-context retrieval task we evaluate, and matches or outperforms one with about 4 times that budget, while using constant inference memory. The largest remaining gap to full attention at small language model scale is on RULER. SSA makes a fixed number of tokens useful over a longer context, and since it reads memory with standard attention, we propose that it can be stacked with KV cache eviction methods. We also pretrain and post-train 400M-parameter models and measure how SSA's training and inference costs scale with context length and model size. Together, these experiments examine the capabilities and limitations of learned memory retention for long-context sequence modeling.

items.title_zh: 状态空间注意力（State Space Attention）：学习上下文相关的记忆保留
items.abstract_zh: 标准注意力的键值缓存随上下文长度线性增长。对其加以限制就引出了一个问题：序列模型应为长上下文推理保留什么。我们认为这一选择应当被学习，并提出状态空间注意力（State Space Attention, SSA），它学习保留一组有界的过去表示，并用标准注意力读取这些表示。一个学习得到的评分器会根据新到达的上下文和记忆的其余部分对每个块重新评分。于是，固定上下文 Transformer 是始终保留最近 token 的特例。我们联合训练评分器和读取器，要么从对记忆的可微软加权逐步过渡到硬保留，要么从一开始就采用硬保留。为了给评分器产生信号，我们在训练期间生成监督样本，这一技术我们称为 recovery。我们在检索、变量跟踪、多跳推理和语言建模任务上，将 SSA 与循环模型、有界记忆注意力方法和全注意力 Transformer 进行比较。在我们的检索和推理基准上，SSA 在大多数任务上与全注意力相当或差距在几个百分点以内，在我们评估的每个长上下文检索任务上，都远远优于具有相同可读预算的 Transformer，并且与具有约 4 倍该预算的 Transformer 相当或更优，同时使用恒定的推理内存。在小语言模型规模下，与全注意力相比剩余的最大差距在 RULER 上。SSA 使固定数量的 token 在更长的上下文中发挥作用，并且由于它用标准注意力读取记忆，我们提出它可以与 KV 缓存驱逐方法叠加。我们还预训练和后训练了 400M 参数模型，并测量 SSA 的训练和推理成本如何随上下文长度和模型大小扩展。这些实验共同考察了用于长上下文序列建模的学习式记忆保留的能力和局限性。

items.title_en: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
items.title_zh: 具身智能未通过镜像测试：一面简单的镜子即可击溃机器人策略
items.abstract_en: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.
items.abstract_zh: 一面简单的镜子能否暴露当今机器人操作策略的局限？受动物认知中镜像自我识别测试启发，我们考察机器人策略能否在含自身倒影的场景中可靠地操作物体。我们构建 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，保持任务目标、成功判据与策略检查点不变，对比无镜基线、单镜、双镜与镜面桌面四种条件。在涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界动作模型与智能体策略的五个策略上，各镜像条件均降低总体成功率：三种条件平均下降 10.8 至 56.7 个百分点，镜面桌面条件下降达 62.5 个百分点。由于镜子也是物理障碍，我们与几何匹配的非反射面板对照；50–88% 的镜像特异性失败没有机器人与面板接触的记录，说明单纯碰撞不足以解释性能退化。轨迹与接触分析揭示出与“瞄准倒影中的幻影物体”和真实物体空间定位错误相一致的行为。π0.5 与 FastWAM 的真机实验同样显示竖直镜面与镜面桌面下成功率下降。这些发现表明多种机器人策略对反射环境存在共同脆弱性，并推动反射感知的具身智能评测。
items.highlight_zh: 镜像场景令机器人策略成功率最多下降 62.5 个百分点
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：如今的机器人操作策略（包括视觉-语言-动作模型）在干净、无干扰的场景里表现不错，但真实环境常有镜子、玻璃等反射面。作者借用动物认知里的“镜像自我识别测试”发问：机器人会不会被自己的倒影骗到？
- 方法：构建基准 RoboDojo-Mirror，在保持任务目标、成功判据与模型权重不变的前提下，把同一批任务分别放到无镜、单镜、双镜和镜面桌面上测试；另设几何形状相同但不可反射的面板作对照，并用轨迹与接触记录分析失败原因；再在真实机器人上用 π0.5 与 FastWAM 验证。
- 结果：五个策略在所有镜像条件下成功率都下降，平均降低 10.8–56.7 个百分点，镜面桌面最多降 62.5 个百分点。对照实验显示 50–88% 的镜像相关失败并未发生机器人与面板的接触，说明不是单纯碰撞所致；行为分析指向“把倒影当真物体去抓”和“真实物体定位偏移”。
- 为何重要：它揭示不同架构的具身智能共享同一类脆弱性，提示评测必须纳入反射等光学干扰，而不能只在理想场景中比较成功率。

items.title_en: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding
items.abstract_en: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. We give six open reasoning models of 4B to 14B parameters such landscapes, with win curves from eBay closing prices and from a simulated advertising market (AuctionNet), and score their bids on held-out auctions against an exact calculator. Because the agent is handed the estimates, the lost value can be split by cause. Two failures belong to the models. They pass over the best option even when the values written in their own trace already rank it first, and their wrong answers lean toward the highest bid on the menu. The lean is about the bid's size, not its place in the list, and it survives sampling. At 768 forced tokens on eBay, under pay-your-bid pricing, the wrong answers cost bidders 7-17% of the surplus the calculator's bids earn. Arithmetic errors are rare. Two further losses come from operator choices. A token cap cuts traces short: allowed to stop on their own within 4,096 tokens, five models recover 91-100% of the calculator's lead over a model that does no reasoning. Asking for the answer while the reasoning block is still open misreads it: closing the block first lifts the weakest model from 42% to 84% on eBay and from 24% to 81% on AuctionNet. Finally, an audit that flags bids disagreeing with the trace's own numbers, and overrides them with the calculator's bid, raises the share of the calculator's lead recovered at 768 forced tokens from 42-85% to 84-100% on eBay under nested cross-validation, and the same reader settings transfer from eBay to AuctionNet.

items.title_zh: 预算、读出还是推理？小型推理模型在拍卖竞价中何处损失价值
items.abstract_zh: 广告平台和市场向竞标者展示竞价景观（bid landscape），即每个候选出价的预计获胜概率，并越来越多地让基于推理语言模型的智能体选择出价。我们向六个 4B 至 14B 参数的开源推理模型提供此类景观，获胜曲线来自 eBay 成交价和模拟广告市场（AuctionNet），并在留出拍卖上将其出价与精确计算器进行评分。由于智能体已获得估计值，价值损失可按原因拆分。两类失败属于模型本身。即使其自身轨迹中写出的数值已将该选项排在第一，它们仍会略过最佳选项；并且其错误答案倾向于菜单上的最高出价。这种倾向与出价大小有关，而非其在列表中的位置，并且在采样后仍然存在。在 eBay 上、按出价付费（pay-your-bid）定价、强制 768 个 token 时，错误答案使竞标者损失计算器出价所获盈余的 7-17%。算术错误很少。另外两类损失来自操作者选择。token 上限会截断轨迹：若允许在 4,096 个 token 内自行停止，五个模型可恢复计算器相对于不进行推理的模型所具领先优势的 91-100%。在推理块仍打开时索取答案会造成误读：先关闭该块可将最弱模型在 eBay 上从 42% 提升至 84%，在 AuctionNet 上从 24% 提升至 81%。最后，一项审计会标记与轨迹自身数值不一致的出价，并用计算器出价覆盖它们，在嵌套交叉验证下，将强制 768 个 token 时恢复计算器领先优势的比例在 eBay 上从 42-85% 提升至 84-100%，且相同的读取器设置可从 eBay 迁移到 AuctionNet。

items.title_en: DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT
items.abstract_en: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-policy distillation (OPD), where the CT teacher selectively guides the X-ray student's reasoning trajectories to transfer 3D anatomical knowledge. Finally, manifest the dream adapts the acquired reasoning capabilities from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) to real clinical X-rays. Experiments across two VLM backbones on 3D-RAD and ReXVQA demonstrate DiCT's effectiveness across radiological reasoning tasks, achieving a 1.66 percentage point improvement over a CT reconstruction-based baseline on 3D-RAD Abnormality Identification with 12.77$\times$ lower inference computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT.

items.title_zh: DiCT：通过想象CT教会X射线视觉-语言模型推理
items.abstract_zh: 使用X射线进行诊断通常需要推理异常的三维位置及其与周围解剖结构的空间关系，然而由于二维投影中空间信息的丢失，此类推理仍具挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Dreaming in CT（DiCT），一个三阶段渐进式CT到X射线推理迁移框架，利用CT视觉-语言模型（VLM）指导X射线VLM。通过这种CT引导的迁移，学生模型获得融入CT信息的三维推理能力，使其能够在推理时无需显式CT重建而直接从二维X射线进行推理。该框架以instruct the dreamer（指导梦想者）开始，为X射线学生模型赋予初始的面向CT的推理能力，并建立一个结构化接口，用于区分X射线观察与CT想象。在此结构基础上，visualize the dream（可视化梦境）引入CT引导的同策略蒸馏（OPD），其中CT教师选择性地指导X射线学生模型的推理轨迹，以迁移三维解剖知识。最后，manifest the dream（显现梦境）将所获得的推理能力从数字重建放射影像（DRR）适配到真实临床X射线。在两个VLM骨干网络上于3D-RAD和ReXVQA上进行的实验表明，DiCT在放射学推理任务中有效，在3D-RAD异常识别上相较基于CT重建的基线提升1.66个百分点，同时推理计算量降低12.77倍。代码见 https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT。

items.title_en: Verifier Choice is a Benchmark Design Variable: Auditing Structural Counting Evaluation in Text-to-Image Models
items.abstract_en: Automatic evaluation is now central to text-to-image benchmarking, but the verifier that converts generated images into scores is often treated as an implementation detail. We argue that this is unsafe: an automatic benchmark score is a property of the image generator, prompt distribution, verifier, verifier-use protocol, and scoring rule, not of the generator alone. We study this issue in structural counting, a controlled setting where human-visible counts can be audited. We construct a verifier-centric audit suite over seven counting objects: cell phones, chairs, and traffic lights for object counting, and clover leaflets, dresser drawer fronts, power-strip sockets, and turbine blades for substructure counting. Across 6,240 generated images from Qwen-Image-2512 and FLUX.2-dev, we compare open MLLM verifiers under count-only, reject-aware, zero-shot and few-shot protocols, plus TIFA-like target queries, a detector baseline, and frontier closed-model checks on two hard objects. On a balanced 2,280-image evaluation split, aggregate score matching can coexist with image-level disagreement, and verifier-use protocols and generator distributions change the measured reliability. Every verifier-protocol configuration also shrinks the human score difference between the two generators, by 7.5-25.0 pp, and with a third generator, Z-Image, all four tested protocols reverse the human ordering of Z-Image and FLUX.2-dev on our fixed prompt suite. GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 checks do not remove the failure modes: GPT-5.5 still has only 59.92% clover valid-count fidelity, while Claude Opus 4.7 has lower same-slice agreement ($κ=0.432$). We propose reporting automatic benchmark scores with a factorized verifier reliability profile: aggregate score gap, image-level agreement, generator-comparison distortion, valid-image count fidelity, rejection behavior, output compliance, and directional bias.

items.title_zh: 验证器选择是基准设计变量：审计文本到图像模型中的结构计数评估
items.abstract_zh: 自动评估如今已成为文本到图像基准测试的核心，但将生成图像转换为分数的验证器往往被视为实现细节。我们认为这不安全：自动基准分数是图像生成器、提示分布、验证器、验证器使用协议和评分规则的属性，而不仅是生成器本身的属性。我们在结构计数这一可控设置中研究该问题，其中人类可见的计数可以被审计。我们构建了一个以验证器为中心的审计套件，覆盖七个计数对象：用于目标计数的手机、椅子和交通灯，以及用于子结构计数的三叶草小叶、梳妆台抽屉面板、电源插排插座和涡轮叶片。在来自 Qwen-Image-2512 和 FLUX.2-dev 的 6,240 张生成图像上，我们比较了开放 MLLM 验证器在仅计数、拒绝感知、零样本和少样本协议下的表现，并加入类似 TIFA 的目标查询、一个检测器基线，以及对两个困难对象的前沿闭源模型检查。在一个平衡的 2,280 张图像评估划分上，聚合分数匹配可以与图像级不一致并存，且验证器使用协议和生成器分布会改变所测得的可靠性。每一种验证器-协议配置还都会缩小两个生成器之间的人类分数差，缩小幅度为 7.5–25.0 个百分点；并且加入第三个生成器 Z-Image 后，在我们固定的提示套件上，所有四种测试协议都逆转了 Z-Image 与 FLUX.2-dev 的人类排序。GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.7 的检查并未消除这些失效模式：GPT-5.5 在三叶草有效计数保真度上仍仅为 59.92%，而 Claude Opus 4.7 的同切片一致性更低（κ=0.432）。我们提出用分解式验证器可靠性画像来报告自动基准分数：聚合分数差、图像级一致性、生成器比较失真、有效图像计数保真度、拒绝行为、输出合规性和方向性偏差。

items.title_en: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
items.abstract_en: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at https://github.com/IRIS-LAB-whu/SemLite-GS.

items.title_zh: SemLite-GS：面向无人机倾斜影像轻量级建筑重建的语义选择性并行高斯泼溅
items.abstract_zh: 轻量级三维建筑模型可支持城市空间分析，但其生产通常需要稠密场景重建、建筑提取和网格简化。尽管三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）比传统多视图立体更高效，但现有大规模方法缺乏语义选择与并行实例级训练。我们提出 SemLite-GS，一个以建筑为中心的框架，可从大规模无人机倾斜影像重建轻量级建筑网格。首先，正交参考图建立全局一致的建筑身份，并将其传播到倾斜视图，以形成相机-实例对和感兴趣区域。其次，语义选择性并行 PGSR 训练在相关图像区域内联合处理多个对，同时仅更新目标高斯；上下文高斯保持固定以保持可见性。第三，从渲染深度图、不透明度图和法线图中提取的建筑平面引导有符号距离场优化，生成具有自适应多边形分配和明确定义结构边界的网格。在多个大规模无人机数据集上的实验表明，与代表性的全场景 3DGS 方法相比，我们的 SemLite-GS 显著减少了建筑重建时间。在相当的多边形预算下，与传统的稠密重建后接网格简化相比，SemLite-GS 在保留主要平面结构和锐利建筑过渡方面表现更优。源代码见 https://github.com/IRIS-LAB-whu/SemLite-GS。

items.title_en: Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them
items.abstract_en: A 4-bit KV cache reads about half the bytes of FP8, but Hopper GPUs have no FP4 hardware and little instruction-issue capacity per byte of memory bandwidth, so 4-bit values must be decoded in software. On H200, vLLM's NVFP4 KV path (FlashInfer's decode) reaches 10-20% of memory bandwidth and is up to 1.7x slower than FP8. NVBit instruction counts show two causes: the kernels behind vLLM's 4-bit paths (FlashInfer NVFP4, Triton UltraQuant) execute 2-6x Hopper's issue budget per byte and serialize loading, decoding and matrix multiplies. Our Hopper-native decode kernel overlaps a TMA producer warp with two compute warpgroups, lays the cache out at write time so decoded values feed the tensor cores from registers, and swaps the matrix operands so small query groups need no padding. On H200 it reaches 67-75% of peak bandwidth at batch 32-128 and at all 11 shapes is 1.12-1.49x faster than the faster of XQA and FlashAttention-4's proposed native FP8. Inside vLLM, with an accuracy recipe (K mean removal and rotation, 4 BF16 sink tokens, BF16 layer 0), it decodes 1.12-1.64x faster per step on Llama-3.1-8B than vLLM's FlashInfer FP8 path at batch 8 and above (1.04-1.24x over FlashAttention-4's FP8), is level at batch 1, and holds 1.63x as many tokens. On one H200 under a reasoning-like request stream, the highest rate at which 99% of requests meet the latency targets is 1.23-1.32x FP8's on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.67-2.20x on Qwen2.5-72B, as the cache becomes the limit; prefill-heavy streams are worse (7% slower prefill). On five 7B-32B models, repeated runs show no significant accuracy difference from BF16 KV. In Qwen2-family models, whose reasoning variants collapse under FP8 KV, layer 0's key mean is almost entirely the key-projection bias identified by prior work, seen through RoPE and computable from the weights alone; keeping that layer in BF16 restores FP8 KV and, with K mean removal, 4-bit KV.

items.title_zh: Hopper GPU上的快速4比特KV缓存解码：现有内核为何慢以及如何修复
items.abstract_zh: 4比特KV缓存读取的字节数约为FP8的一半，但Hopper GPU没有FP4硬件，且每字节内存带宽对应的指令发射能力很小，因此4比特值必须在软件中解码。在H200上，vLLM的NVFP4 KV路径（FlashInfer的解码）仅达到内存带宽的10-20%，且比FP8最多慢1.7倍。NVBit指令计数显示两个原因：vLLM的4比特路径（FlashInfer NVFP4、Triton UltraQuant）背后的内核每字节执行的指令量是Hopper发射预算的2-6倍，并且将加载、解码和矩阵乘法串行化。我们的Hopper原生解码内核将一个TMA生产者warp与两个计算warpgroup重叠，在写入时对缓存进行布局，使解码后的值从寄存器送入张量核心，并交换矩阵操作数，使小查询组无需填充。在H200上，它在批次32-128时达到峰值带宽的67-75%，并且在所有11种形状上比XQA和FlashAttention-4所提出的原生FP8中较快者快1.12-1.49倍。在vLLM内部，配合一套精度方案（K均值移除与旋转、4个BF16 sink token、BF16第0层），在Llama-3.1-8B上批次8及以上时每步解码比vLLM的FlashInfer FP8路径快1.12-1.64倍（相较FlashAttention-4的FP8为1.04-1.24倍），批次1时持平，并可容纳1.63倍的token数。在单块H200上，在类推理请求流下，99%请求满足延迟目标的最高速率为：Llama-3.1-8B上为FP8的1.23-1.32倍，Qwen2.5-72B上为1.67-2.20倍（此时缓存成为瓶颈）；prefill密集的流表现更差（prefill慢7%）。在五个7B-32B模型上，重复运行显示与BF16 KV相比无显著精度差异。在Qwen2系列模型中，其推理变体在FP8 KV下会崩溃，第0层的键均值几乎完全是先前工作所识别的键投影偏置，经过RoPE作用后可见，且仅由权重即可计算；将该层保持为BF16可恢复FP8 KV，若再结合K均值移除，则可恢复4比特KV。

items.title_en: Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\% Poisoning
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic manipulation, but their reliance on demonstrations exposes them to backdoor threats. Among these threats, trajectory-level targeted backdoors are particularly challenging and may pose greater safety risks than behavior-disrupting attacks: rather than merely causing task failures or local action deviations, they must sustain closed-loop redirection to complete an attacker-specified multi-step task. To reliably induce such behaviors, existing methods typically rely on high poisoning rates to obtain sufficient target-trajectory supervision. However, high poisoning rates may compromise clean-task performance, whereas low rates leave target-trajectory supervision scarce and backdoor learning vulnerable to interference from dominant clean-task updates. To resolve this trade-off at low poisoning rates, we propose a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action. Stage I freezes the policy and uses differentiable rendering and multimodal supervision to optimize a 3D trigger's texture, translation, and scale, strengthening trigger-target associations from limited poisoned demonstrations. Building on the optimized trigger, Stage II applies source-selective dual-LoRA adaptation to decouple clean and backdoor updates and mitigate their interference, followed by learned column-wise calibration and analytic fusion into a unified policy. Experiments on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ across four LIBERO suites show consistent gains over all evaluated attack baselines. With only 1% poisoned data, our method achieves 86.4% target success and 95.2% clean-task success on OpenVLA-OFT in LIBERO-Spatial. Real-robot trials also demonstrate trajectory-level hijacking.

items.title_zh: 稀疏投毒，强力劫持：仅需1%投毒的视觉-语言-动作模型高效轨迹级后门
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作的发展，但其对演示数据的依赖使其面临后门威胁。在这些威胁中，轨迹级定向后门尤其具有挑战性，并且可能比破坏行为的攻击带来更大的安全风险：它们不仅要造成任务失败或局部动作偏差，还必须维持闭环重定向以完成攻击者指定的多步骤任务。为可靠地诱导此类行为，现有方法通常依赖高投毒率以获得足够的目标轨迹监督。然而，高投毒率可能损害干净任务性能，而低投毒率会使目标轨迹监督稀缺，并使后门学习易受占主导的干净任务更新的干扰。为在低投毒率下解决这一权衡，我们提出一个由视觉、语言和动作引导的两阶段协同优化框架。阶段I冻结策略，并使用可微渲染和多模态监督来优化3D触发器的纹理、平移和尺度，从有限的投毒演示中增强触发器与目标之间的关联。在优化后的触发器基础上，阶段II应用源选择性双LoRA适配来解耦干净更新和后门更新并减轻其相互干扰，随后进行学习到的按列校准并解析融合为统一策略。在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、π0和π0.5上跨四个LIBERO套件的实验表明，相对于所有评估的攻击基线均取得一致增益。仅使用1%投毒数据，我们的方法在LIBERO-Spatial中的OpenVLA-OFT上达到86.4%的目标成功率和95.2%的干净任务成功率。真实机器人试验也展示了轨迹级劫持。

items.title_en: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
items.title_zh: AutoMaster：通过使同一模型成为更好的教师实现自主后训练
items.abstract_en: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a student model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B student models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
items.abstract_zh: 仅凭任务成功并不能确定后训练应强化哪些行为。即使是成功的教师轨迹也可能包含无依据的假设、无效重复或表面化验证。我们提出 Skill-FT（Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning），它使用自然语言技能在教师 rollout 期间抑制不良习惯并引出代表性不足的有效行为，然后在所得轨迹上微调目标模型。我们提出 AutoMaster，一种自主后训练系统，其中 LLM 智能体通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及来自 rollout 和目标模型评估的反馈来开发这些干预。在使用 4B 和 9B 目标模型的 Terminal、Search 和软件工程任务中，在教师、任务池、训练集规模和 SFT 配方保持固定的情况下，AutoMaster 相较于在成功的无引导教师轨迹上进行 Vanilla SFT，将平均性能提高 1.42–8.99 个百分点。结合消融和轨迹分析，这些结果表明行为塑造可以使固定模型成为更有效的教师。我们进一步发现，在所有六种设置中，SFT 期间保留技能指令比移除它们获得更高的平均性能，尽管评估时这些指令不存在且监督输出相同。这些发现表明，将技能上下文保留为训练示范的一部分可以支持更好的行为内化。

items.title_en: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
items.title_zh: DACA：用于零样本3D视觉定位的双锚协作智能体
items.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
items.abstract_zh: 3D视觉定位（3D-VG）是一项连接自然语言与3D空间的任务，是具身智能和人机交互的基础能力。尽管近期3D-VG智能体克服了对预处理3D点云的依赖，但它们本质上采用单向、流水线式的工具调用架构。该架构将语义理解与几何重建分离，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。为解决这一缺陷，本文提出双锚协作智能体（DACA），将3D-VG重新解释为语义-几何双锚协作推理范式。DACA包含两个互补的专用工具：语义锚工具持有目标的视觉语义特征，并通过光流和VLM局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚工具持有目标的3D空间几何特征，并通过体素化和多关键点投影执行全局空间推理。两个组件通过标准化工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一个感知-动作步骤，形成闭环优化。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上的实验表明，零样本DACA在ScanRefer上取得73.6%的总体Acc@0.25，在Nr3D上取得70.4%的总体准确率，远超最新的零样本3D-VG方法。代码和模型见 https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

items.title_en: Context-Aware Autoregressive Image Generation for Emerging Reasoning Properties
items.title_zh: 面向涌现推理特性的上下文感知自回归图像生成
items.abstract_en: Autoregressive image generation has recently emerged as a competitive visual generation paradigm, yet its generation order is often predefined or heuristic, such as next-patch prediction, random-order prediction, or one-step generation for specific scales. We observe that these strategies can cause models to overlook important structural dependencies in images, thereby limiting both structural robustness and reasoning capability. In this work, we propose a context-aware autoregressive generation framework, where the model dynamically determines the next token location based on global context and current local information. Rather than following a fixed or random order, our method allows the generation process to adapt to image structure and semantic dependencies. Extensive experiments show that context-aware generation significantly improves structural robustness across different image AR paradigms, including masked autoregressive and scale-wise autoregressive models. Beyond quantitative improvements, we further observe emerging reasoning properties: the model can better understand complex semantic instructions and generate images that more faithfully follow the given guidance. These findings suggest that generation order is a critical yet underexplored factor in image autoregressive modeling, and that context-aware decoding can unlock stronger reasoning-aware visual generation capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/Hpesojyjx/Saccades-AR.
items.abstract_zh: 自回归图像生成最近已成为一种具有竞争力的视觉生成范式，但其生成顺序通常是预定义或启发式的，例如下一图块预测、随机顺序预测，或针对特定尺度的一步生成。我们观察到，这些策略会导致模型忽略图像中重要的结构依赖关系，从而限制结构鲁棒性和推理能力。在这项工作中，我们提出一种上下文感知的自回归生成框架，其中模型基于全局上下文和当前局部信息动态确定下一个 token 的位置。我们的方法不遵循固定或随机顺序，而是使生成过程能够适应图像结构和语义依赖。大量实验表明，上下文感知生成在不同图像自回归范式（包括掩码自回归和尺度式自回归模型）中显著提升了结构鲁棒性。除定量改进外，我们进一步观察到涌现出的推理特性：模型能够更好地理解复杂的语义指令，并生成更忠实地遵循给定引导的图像。这些发现表明，生成顺序是图像自回归建模中一个关键但尚未被充分探索的因素，并且上下文感知解码可以释放更强的推理感知视觉生成能力。代码见 https://github.com/Hpesojyjx/Saccades-AR。

items.title_en: Box-conditional Hypothesis Testing for Out-of-Distribution Object Detection
items.abstract_en: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is essential for ensuring the reliability and safety of object detectors in real-world deployment. We treat the decision on a detected box as a hypothesis test with the null hypothesis that the box covers an object of an in-distribution (ID) class. The null distribution changes with the size of the box and its contact with the image border, and the detector observes both. The test can therefore rank a box only against ID boxes of the same size and border contact, which gives a distribution-free bound on the false-alarm rate for each of them and uncovers the separation that one null distribution hides. The power of the test also rests on the layer it reads. Layers built only for the ID classes have no reason to keep what sets an unknown object apart, so the test reads the features before them. We propose \textbf{PLUM}, a training-free score that pools the last backbone stage inside the box and ranks its distance to the ID classes among ID boxes of the same size and border contact. On the standard benchmark, PLUM reaches the highest AUROC among the compared methods without external models, with 91.5 and 94.5 on PASCAL-VOC and 95.1 and 97.5 on BDD100K. Code: https://github.com/DDOZMI/PLUM

items.title_zh: 用于分布外目标检测的框条件假设检验
items.abstract_zh: 检测分布外（OOD）目标对于确保目标检测器在现实部署中的可靠性和安全性至关重要。我们将对检测框的决策视为假设检验，零假设是该框覆盖一个分布内（ID）类别的目标。零分布随框的大小及其与图像边界的接触而变化，而检测器观察到这两者。因此，该检验只能将框与具有相同大小和边界接触的 ID 框进行排序比较，这为每个框给出了无分布假设的误报率界，并揭示了单一零分布所掩盖的分离。检验的功效还取决于它所读取的层。仅为 ID 类别构建的层没有理由保留使未知目标与众不同的内容，因此该检验读取它们之前的特征。我们提出 PLUM，一种无需训练的分数，它池化框内最后一个骨干阶段，并在具有相同大小和边界接触的 ID 框中对某框到 ID 类别的距离进行排序。在标准基准上，PLUM 在无外部模型的比较方法中达到最高 AUROC，在 PASCAL-VOC 上为 91.5 和 94.5，在 BDD100K 上为 95.1 和 97.5。代码：https://github.com/DDOZMI/PLUM

items.title_en: FACT: Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training for Speculative Decoding
items.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. However, better draft predictions and longer accepted continuations do not necessarily produce faster generation. To examine this gap, we present FACT (Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training), an experimental framework for studying how drafter training, candidate allocation, and execution conditions jointly affect acceptance and latency. Using a lightweight feature-prediction drafter with a frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct target under greedy decoding, we first examine how training translates into accepted tokens. Backpropagating through predicted-feature rollouts with greater weight on early steps improves acceptance by 15-24% over uniformly weighted detached training, yet average rollout proxy cross-entropy does not reliably rank drafters by acceptance. Beyond prediction quality, the placement of draft candidates also matters: with a fixed 256-node budget and matched per-depth widths, replacing static allocation with confidence-guided allocation increases speedup over autoregressive decoding from $1.46\times$ to $2.02\times$ on HumanEval and from $1.31\times$ to $1.75\times$ on MT-Bench. This allocation benefit extends to an independently trained drafter, but stronger training does not consistently amplify it, showing that the two improvements do not necessarily reinforce each other. Even these speed gains depend on execution conditions: changing only host-thread settings can nearly eliminate speedup without changing acceptance. Together, these findings show why training and allocation must be evaluated jointly using both acceptance and end-to-end latency under controlled execution conditions.

items.title_zh: FACT：面向推测解码的固定预算分配与跨步训练
items.abstract_zh: 推测解码通过在单次目标模型前向传递中验证多个草稿token来加速语言模型生成。然而，更好的草稿预测和更长的被接受连续片段并不必然带来更快的生成。为考察这一差距，我们提出FACT（固定预算分配与跨步训练），一个用于研究草稿模型训练、候选分配与执行条件如何共同影响接受率和延迟的实验框架。在贪心解码下，使用轻量级特征预测草稿模型和冻结的Llama-3-8B-Instruct目标模型，我们首先考察训练如何转化为被接受的token。通过对预测特征展开进行反向传播，并对早期步骤赋予更大权重，相比均匀加权且分离梯度的训练，接受率提升15–24%；但平均展开代理交叉熵并不能可靠地按接受率对草稿模型排序。除预测质量外，草稿候选的放置也很重要：在固定256节点预算且各深度宽度匹配的情况下，用置信度引导分配替代静态分配，可将相对自回归解码的加速比在HumanEval上从$1.46\times$提高到$2.02\times$，在MT-Bench上从$1.31\times$提高到$1.75\times$。这种分配收益可扩展到独立训练的草稿模型，但更强的训练并不总能放大该收益，表明这两种改进未必相互增强。即使这些速度收益也依赖于执行条件：仅改变主机线程设置就可能在不改变接受率的情况下几乎消除加速。综合来看，这些发现表明为何必须在受控执行条件下，同时使用接受率和端到端延迟来联合评估训练与分配。

items.title_en: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
items.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details. We study visual moment memory, the ability to retain such details from key moments for subsequent manipulation. To support this study, we introduce VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring memory of spatial locations, visual appearances, and their associations. We further propose MomentMem, a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories. This separation enables us to evaluate memory selection alongside closed-loop task success and to study memorizer generalization independently of the executor. On VMBench, MomentMem achieves 49.9% average success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 31.7 percentage points. Moreover, we find that the memorizer transfers well to unseen appearances zero-shot. It can also adapt to an unseen task with only a few memory annotations, reaching 43.7% success, close to the 44.3% obtained with full memory supervision. Further experiments show competitive performance on RMBench and improvements in real-robot manipulation. These results highlight the value of retaining sparse visual evidence for memory-dependent manipulation. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MomentMem.

items.title_zh: MomentMem：为机器人操作记忆关键瞬间
items.abstract_zh: 机器人操作通常需要记住已无法观测的视觉信息，例如物体的原始位置。现有方法通常依赖完整观测历史，而完整观测历史在长时程下会变得冗余；或依赖文本摘要，而文本摘要可能遗漏精确的视觉细节。我们研究视觉瞬间记忆，即保留关键瞬间的此类细节以供后续操作使用的能力。为支持这项研究，我们提出 VMBench，一套长时程操作任务，要求记忆空间位置、视觉外观及其关联。我们进一步提出 MomentMem，一种分层架构，其中基于 VLM 的记忆器选择关键帧，执行器以所选记忆为条件预测动作。这种分离使我们能够将记忆选择与闭环任务成功率一起评估，并独立于执行器研究记忆器的泛化能力。在 VMBench 上，MomentMem 达到 49.9% 的平均成功率，比评估中最强基线高出 31.7 个百分点。此外，我们发现记忆器能够零样本很好地迁移到未见过的外观。它还能仅用少量记忆标注适应未见过的任务，达到 43.7% 的成功率，接近使用完整记忆监督获得的 44.3%。进一步实验表明，在 RMBench 上具有竞争力的性能，并在真实机器人操作中有所提升。这些结果凸显了为依赖记忆的操作保留稀疏视觉证据的价值。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MomentMem 获取。
